note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: TypeScript: ts/src/toml.ts has `import { Tabnas, Rule, Lex, Plugin, EMPTY } from '@tabnas/parser'`, a value import for `Tabnas` (`new Tabnas().use(jsonic).parse(grammarText)` in `Toml`) and for `EMPTY` (passed to `lex.token` in `makeTomlStringMatcher`), and type-only for `Rule`, `Lex` and `Plugin`; ts/package.json lists @tabnas/parser in peerDependencies. Rust: `use tabnas::{...}` in rs/src/lib.rs, node.rs, refs.rs, strmatcher.rs, datematcher.rs and values.rs, and `pub use tabnas::TabnasError as TomlError` in lib.rs, with `tabnas` (package tabnas-parser) in [dependencies] of rs/Cargo.toml. Go: no non-test .go file under go/ imports github.com/tabnas/parser/go; toml.go, refs.go, rulemap.go, strmatcher.go and datematcher.go import no tabnas module but github.com/tabnas/jsonic/go. Where TypeScript constructs the engine itself, toml.go gets one from jsonic's own `Make` (`jsonic.Make().Parse(grammarText)` in `apply`, `jsonic.Make()` in `MakeJsonic`), and the Go files name the engine's types through the aliases in jsonic's go/engine.go (`jsonic.Jsonic`, `jsonic.Rule`, `jsonic.Context`, `jsonic.Token`, `jsonic.OrderedMap`). go/go.mod requires the parser directly only because the test file go/toml_tsv_test.go imports it, for `tabnas.TabnasError` in `errorCode`.
parser.repair: To agree on having it: the non-test Go files would import github.com/tabnas/parser/go for the engine types they now take from jsonic; go/go.mod already requires it directly. To agree on not having it: ts/src/toml.ts would take `Tabnas`, `EMPTY`, `Rule` and `Lex` from @tabnas/jsonic, which re-exports them under the same names (jsonic's ts/src/jsonic.ts), and the engine's `Plugin` under the name `TabnasPlugin` (`export type { Plugin as TabnasPlugin } from '@tabnas/parser'`), because jsonic's own `Plugin` type is a different one whose first argument is a `Jsonic` instance; ts/package.json would then drop the @tabnas/parser peer. In Rust that move is not available today: tabnas-jsonic re-exports only `TabnasError` (as `JsonicError`), so jsonic's rs/src/lib.rs would first have to re-export the engine's items before rs/src here could take them from it and rs/Cargo.toml drop `tabnas` from [dependencies]. Either way the engine stays in every port's build, because jsonic depends on it in all three (peerDependencies of its ts/package.json, the import in its go/engine.go, [dependencies] of its rs/Cargo.toml). The handover page parser/doc/handover/README.md of 2026-10-04 does not raise this difference, but item 3 of its "Decisions waiting on the maintainer" proposes trying `use(json)` in place of `use(jsonic)` in toml: that edits the same `new Tabnas().use(jsonic)` call, and the second direction relies on @tabnas/jsonic remaining a dependency of the TypeScript port. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
